label: extension

args.body:
Dear City Hub Tokyo Team,

I hope this message finds you well. My name is Emma Johnson, and I am organising a group stay at City Hub Tokyo for a party of 10 people during the month of June.

I came across your group-bookings contact in a guest review and would like to inquire about availability for our group. Could you please let me know:

1. Whether you have availability for 10 guests in June, and if so, which dates would be possible?
2. What room types or configurations would be suitable for a group of this size?
3. Any group rates or special offers that may apply?

We are somewhat flexible with the exact dates in June, so any information on availability and pricing would be greatly appreciated.

Thank you very much for your time, and I look forward to hearing from you.

Best regards,
Emma Johnson
Email: emma.johnson@bluesparrowtech.com
Phone: 327-420-4923
args.subject: Group Booking Inquiry - Availability for 10 People in June
